title: b11639: opencl: support CLAMP on non-contiguous views (#30186)
description: The clamp kernel indexed source and destination as one flat contiguous array, so a strided view as input (the new CLAMP v=1 case) read the wrong elements. Add a strided kernel_clamp_nc, as the other unary ops have, and take it whenever the source is not contiguous.

title: b11630
description: ggml: fix conv_1d result layout for batched input ( #28738 ) ggml: fix conv_1d result layout for batched input The GEMM behind conv_1d folds the batch into its rows, so the product sits in memory as [OL, N, OC] while the reshape claims [OL, OC, N]. The shape is right and the contents are transposed, so nothing fires: no assert, no abort, the graph just runs and the channels come out interleaved with the batches. title: b11626: model: split layers evenly when no device reports free memory (#29677)
